english.note: Use this in an adversative correction meaning “no, rather...” when rejecting a negative statement and asserting the opposite.

examples.english: You don't like this film? No—rather, yes, I really like it.
examples.traditional: 你唔係唔鍾意呢套戲呀？唔，我好鍾意。
